newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon 96 revenues at 55 pct of spending - minister.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon 96 revenues at 55 pct of spending - minister.

text.p: Lebanon's government revenues in 1996 will cover 55 percent of spending, acting Finance Minister Fouad Siniora was quoted on Tuesday as saying.

Asked by al-Amn, the monthly magazine of the Lebanese security forces and police, what the 1996 shortfall of budget revenue to income would be, Siniora said: "About 45 percent but we will try to compensate that somewhat in the coming months".
The 1996 budget law authorises spending of 6,458 billion Lebanese pounds against revenue of 4,022 billion -- or a deficit of 38 percent.
Finance ministry statistics issued in mid-November showed that the deficit reached 3,187 billion pounds at the end of October compared to the planned 2,436 billion.
